decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY identifying the selected LED as OPSCO SK6812MINI-E, LCSC C5149201, RGBW; the package details do not necessarily change its power or data-interface rules.
Selecting the LED daughterboard component does not change the ESP32-S3 module selection.
The LED part identification does not change the standalone USB 3.3V rail, whose current load definition already excludes the 5V-powered LEDs.
The selected LED part has no effect on the battery connector family, pinout, or part number.
The exact SK6812MINI-E part selection leaves the existing 5V boost load and enable-control policy unchanged.
The LED daughterboard component selection does not alter any sensor-board connector or fanout requirement.
Charge status remains displayed through the SK6812 addressable LED chain on GPIO13; the exact daughterboard LED package does not change that interface.
This candidate concerns power-board BOM readiness, while the source identifies the LED daughterboard component and does not modify any current power-board BOM attribute.
The LED part selection does not affect native USB routing, enumeration, flashing, or connector requirements.
The selected LED component is unrelated to the SPS30 connector, supply, and I2C-mode wiring.
The SK6812MINI-E selection does not change the DCDC1 3.3V rail voltage, rating, or listed normal-operation loads.
The LED daughterboard part number and package do not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, cable length, or bus topology.
